description: Per-country rules for a global launch. EXAMPLE STRUCTURE ONLY: the real file must be maintained by legal/trust-and-safety and reviewed on a schedule, because laws change. Do not ship this file's example entries as policy.

safety_resources.note: Shown in the report flow and when a message is held for exploitation. Fill per region from official sources; verify before launch.

XA.note: Example: a country where same-sex relationships are criminalised. Hide orientation and same-gender seeking from everyone, and never reveal them in exports visible to other users.

XB.note: Example: a country with a higher age of majority.

XC.note: Example: a country where political or religious answers carry legal risk.
